provenance: Restricted to the 4 of 8 benchmark questions (qid 1, 3, 10, 41) whose benchmark_dataset.csv question text still matches the live get_rubric(qid) question text, per evaluator_qid_rubric_mismatch_diagnosis.json (seventh pass) and the ninth pass's evaluator_benchmark_repair_package/qid_mapping.json. The excluded 32 cases (qid 7, 15, 22, 50) were scored, via the live production get_rubric(qid) lookup baked into paper2_case_level_results.csv, against a rubric for a different question than the one the benchmark's human raters saw.
selection_limitation: This is a reduced, non-random subset of the original 8-question design, not a fresh sample matched to its intended power. All seven configurations' question-clustered bootstrap CIs now resample only 4 clusters and are correspondingly wide; do not treat this table as replacing the original 8-question design's intended coverage.

paired_full_vs_R_only.interpretation: CI excludes 0 => full composite's error is significantly different from R-only's, at the question-clustered level (now only 4 independent questions -- a much weaker basis for this comparison than the original 8-question design). CI includes 0 => no significant difference detectable.
